samples.question: Two distant broken sockets appear across the top. For each socket, a patch fits only when the four colored edge tabs on the patch meet the same-colored tabs on the socket: top to top, right to right, bottom to bottom, and left to left; do not rotate or swap patches. Each tagged row offers a left patch for the left socket and a right patch for the right socket. Which tag color marks the only row that repairs both sockets? Answer red, green, or blue.
